# Co-op Anything QA tools

Unmodified gameslot Python sources/docs from [cranebeaker/coop-anything](https://github.com/cranebeaker/coop-anything/tree/5b86e5bb10ce864ab9872f2589651f73ffcae5db),
commit `5b86e5bb10ce864ab9872f2589651f73ffcae5db`. MIT license in this directory.
Used to acquire two test slots and register positively identified game PIDs;
